event_name: Date 29 March 2019 Time 18:14 2019 BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 28 - 31 March 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 8 and 9) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine
fact: Alleged causing a collision with car 99 in turn 7.
offence: Alleged breach of the FIA International Sporting Code Appendix L Chapter IV Article 2(d).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and heard from the driver of car 27 (Nico Hulkenberg) and the driver of car 99 (Antonio Giovinazzi) and the team representatives. Neither car was on a push lap, car 27 had just let car 7 pass, and believed car 99 was going slow. Car 99 then sped up and passed car 27 on the inside when the driver of car 27 was not expecting it to do so, remaining on the racing line. The Stewards believe that this was a misunderstanding by the driver of car 27 and a presumption by the driver of car 99.
title: Decision Car 27 Incident With Car 99 In Turn 7
